scenes.summary: You and Kay decide to head for the top of the dam.

lines.text: Endmin, let's get rid of this whole illusion thing for good!
Okay! Once you're ready, grab your honey waffles and let's go!

options: Hold on, give me some time.

scenes.summary: You overcome every obstacle and finally destroy the Malignant Hyphal Mass. With it gone, the threads spreading the hallucinogenic spores fade away, and the remaining spores drift down like drops of honey. Kay sighs at the waste, but you have other plans for these sweet spores.

lines.text: ...We did it?
Endmin! We totally did it! That meanie mushroom's gone! Its weird threads are gone too!
And the people aren't under its control any... Oh no!
Phew... Thank Talos they're just sleeping.
Now that the meanie mushroom's gone, no more hallucinations!
Nuh-uh. They're all snoozy and peaceful.
I'll let them enjoy their sweet little dreams.
Endmin! Come look!
Hmm ... it's sweet...
Nmm...
But first, we should go check on our UWST friends.
It'd be so sad to waste all these sweet spores...
I have a good idea.
A good idea?

options: Are you not going to wake them up?

scenes.summary: The mushroom crisis is finally over. Wuling and the UWST plan to turn the dam into an ecological research facility, while Kay suggests letting the Landbreakers who wandered in lend a hand with the rebuild. The dam once claimed by the mushrooms is ready to start a new chapter.

lines.text: Endmin, Da Pan has helped us re-establish contact with Wuling.
Wuling has assessed the area. No major Blight threats are expected near the dam for now.
I've also handed out fungal safety guides. Follow the steps for proper protection, and no one shall get poisoned again.
Red ones are spicy ... green ones are minty...
Wait, no, no, no!
Now that the Blight Tide has subsided, Tianshi Zhuang and I think the dam could serve a new purpose.
We would like to continue working with the UWST to convert this dam into an ecological research facility!
I've never seen a mushroom get this big in a Blight Tide.
If Wuling's open to restarting research, the UWST's fully on board!
After all, Strain E21 caused an ecological disaster. I've been wanting to make up for it.
But the dam's in bad shape, and we're short on hands...
Oh, oh! You need help with the heavy lifting?
What?
What?
What?
Heh, I'm their new big boss now!
I can fight, and I can also share waffles with them ... and they said I've got this ... uh ... raw and real vibe!
Way better than that ex-boss they never even saw.
Now if I tell them to do something, they just go and do it.
Endmin, they haven't really done anything bad. Can they stay here please?
What do you guys think?
I don't see a problem. We'll need plenty of hands for cleanup and rebuilding. We'll also need people to help keep things going afterwards too.
Food, shelter, honest work. These could keep them off the wrong path.
As long as they actually do the work!
Don't worry! With honey waffles as their reward, they'll move mountains.
If they're staying, maybe they need a new name?
How about ... "Sweetbreakers"?
Shroomkrusher Clan? Sweetbreakers?
Ooooh, I like that!
It's a major biological discovery on Talos-II! There's plenty of research value here. What do you think, Roger?
Those Landbreakers can lend a hand!

options: Sounds better than joining the Bonekrusher Clan.
We need to make sure they won't cause trouble later.

scenes.summary: Kay follows the voice and finds a mountain of honey waffles. The voice warmly invites her to try them. But with you still missing, even a feast like this can't hold her back.

lines.text: See that? It's all yours — every bit of honey waffle.
Whoa ... a whole mountain of honey waffles! Is this all really for me?
Of course. Your wish was "Honey waffles, more honey waffles", so here they are.
Your heart's desire is speaking ... look at all these sweet honey waffles.
Yeah ... honey waffles...
Good. Very good...
What's wrong? You wished for this...
I love honey waffles. I've always wished for more. But...
Now my wish is ... to find the Endmin!
Please bring the Endmin to me.
Why look for the Endmin? All these honey waffles could be yours alone...
You don't get it. I'm gonna find the Endmin myself. I can't let illusions bring the Endmin down.
I've gotta share these honey waffles with her.
lines.textM: I've gotta share these honey waffles with him.

scenes.summary: Kay keeps searching, until "you" suddenly appear beside the mountain of honey waffles. The mysterious voice speaks again, coaxing her to stay here with "you". But Kay's thoughts never leave you or her responsibilities to Endfield. The illusion shatters before her eyes.

lines.text: Everything looks the same around here...
I hope the Endmin didn't get lost...
Kay! Kay!
That's the Endmin's voice! Endmin, where are you?
Kay! Over here!
Look, your Endmin is right there.
The Endmin ... is right next to all the honey waffles?
That's right. It's exactly what you wished for, isn't it? The Endmin and all the honey waffles in the world.
But we were going to the top of the dam...
Why would the Endmin be here with the honey waffles?
Isn't this what you wanted? Even the Endmin went with the honey waffles, just like you. So why are you turning them down?
Honey waffles everywhere... Endmin...
Come on, Kay. Stay here with me.
Honey waffle... Paradise...
So sweet, so golden... Why would anyone ever say no to all these honey waffles?
Yeah, just stay. Listen to your heart...
My heart... I... I...
I want to share the honey waffles with Endmin... because I know you always have so much on your shoulders. Duties, missions... all of it.
Those things ... can only be done by Endmin. Surgeon Warfarin, Miss M3 ... they all believe in you. Everyone does.
So I kept thinking ... what if you could just have a bite of a honey waffle, and take a little break?
I kept wishing... because I knew you were just a little tired. You would never ever give up...
Just stay, Kay... You can't fool your own heart.
You're not the Endmin!
I knew it! You fooled me with Endmin and the honey waffles ... and everyone else got tricked in their own way too!
Stay... Stay and listen to what your heart truly wants...
I've heard enough of your lies! I'm going to find the real Endmin now!
Look at all these honey waffles. It's ours — all of it. This place will be our paradise. No worries, just pure happiness.
No! This is my heart speaking! The true Endmin would never act like you! If I abandon my duty now...
Then I'm not the real Kay either!
...You can't fool your own heart.
You twisted my wish around, and now you're trying to treat me like a little kid?

scenes.summary: Kay hears your voice and rushes toward you. Just before she loses herself completely to the illusions, she finally finds you and breaks free of them once and for all. Regaining your resolve, you and Kay make your way to the top floor, where the Malignant Hyphal Mass is.

lines.text: Kay! Over here!
Kay, are you alright?
...En-Endmin?
A-are you the real Endmin?
Y-you're not gonna stay with that huge mountain of honey waffles?
A huge mountain of honey waffles? Where?
If you're the real Endmin, you'd definitely know my wish!
Wish... Your wish is...
Oh goodie... Endmin's not lost anymore...
I turned around and you were gone. I was so worried you got lost...
I ... I even brought you — Hey, where'd it go?
You mean this?
Endmin ... you saved honey waffles for me...
I looked and looked and looked for you... I thought...
Don't worry, I'm right here. I never left.
Endmin...
It's okay, it's okay... I'm right here.
It's all that meanie mushroom's fault! It even said bad things about you and honey waffles! Unforgivable!
Yeah! I'm ready to fight! Let's pull it out for good!
Oh ... you are the real Endmin!
Oh ... you are the real Endmin!
Sounds like a serious threat. We have to destroy it before it causes any more harm!

options: Of course I am. What are you talking about?
To help everyone who's in trouble?
To hurry back and have some of Da Pan's food?

scenes.summary: The mushroom crisis is over. You head back to the UWST crew mates and check on everyone. All of them are safe and sound.

lines.text: Endmin! You're finally back! Everyone's themselves again!
That sugary smell in the air isn't as strong anymore. Looks like the spores are thinning out.
Strain E21, you really made a huge mess, didn't you? *Sigh* I'm the one to blame. I started all of this...
Mr. Roger, don't feel bad. You and the giant mushroom didn't do anything wrong.
The bad stuff on the mushroom only grew because of the Blight, right?
I remember you saying that ten years ago, it helped feed a lot of people. It made everything sweeter and gave everyone a boost!
That's something to be proud of! You and the giant mushroom did it together!
Think positive! Maybe the giant mushroom just wanted to help more people. So it kept growing... and whoops, it got a bit out of hand!
Thank you ... young lady. Thank you...
The sweetness in the air seems to be getting lighter...
Don't worry. I promise you, we'll put those spores to good use.
Endmin...

scenes.summary: You salvage some old gear from the dam and build a Forge of Sweetness to collect the sweet spores and turn them into honey waffles.

lines.text: What...?! W-what ... what is this?
Forge of the Sky?! Endmin, how did you get this baby all the way here?
So what exactly is this?
I rigged it up from some old gear lying around. This new device is designed to handle all the spores from the dam.
And I'm naming it...
F-Forge of ... Sweetness?
It looks super cool!
Strain E21's evolved spores are not only super sweet, but also rich in nutrients.
This device can collect the spores, remove their hallucinogenic properties, purify the air, and the best part—
It can make honey waffles. From spores to dessert, all in one go!
Ha, so it's basically a honey waffle oven!
First set the portions, then it'll start making honey waffles on its own.
Just be careful not to overload it... Wait, where's Kay?
Aha! I get it — totally, completely, one hundred percent!
Wait—
AND START!
Endmin, watch out!
Endmin, this is the very first honey waffle from the Forge of Sweetness.
Kay, your wish is finally, truly real now.
Once we get rid of the side effects, it's basically premium food.
This is great. Our work can finally help more people.
Yay Endmin! You always know what to do!
I had so much fun on our adventure, Endmin! But I wanna help you with the super important stuff, too...
For Rhodes Island, for Endfield, and for everyone's homeland...
What's it for?

options: I just used Forge of the Sky as inspiration for the look.
Couldn't have done without Kay's honey waffles and mushroom friends.
Right now, enjoying good food is all that matters.
Staying grounded and minding the details matters just as much.
We'll have plenty of chances to build a better Talos-II together.

scenes.summary: Kay is separated from you. As she searches in a panic, a mysterious voice offers to help her find you.

lines.text: What's wrong? Why do you look so worried?
Who are you...?
Are you lost? Did you get separated from your friend?
Yes! My friend wears a dark mask — known as the "Endmin".
Have you seen her?!
Why, yes, of course. Your Endmin is right up ahead.
Come to me ... and I'll give you all you wish for.
Endmin? I've got some honey waffles right here... End...
Endmin, where are you?!
I can't smell you anymore ... where did you go?
Wait, no... The Endmin's on the other side!
No, no, no! That's not the right way!
I heard a dark mushroom showed up ... goes by "Endministrator" or something.
End-what? Do they end things, or fix things?
Look! It's Kay! She's back.
Who's that dark one next to Kay? New face?
Yeah, that's right. Keep going up!
Ugh, can't these new mushrooms be quiet for once?
Kay's definitely the better one.
